_comment: GCB-027 - EPIC TKT-018 Measurement Epoch, per TKT-000. First deliberately-unoptimized OpenROAD/ASAP7 physical pass of gcb_max_reduce (TKT-016). Raw measurement - NOT a signed-off result. Source reports under ./reports/; full P&R artifacts (6_final.{gds,def,v,spef}) left in the isolated P&R env at ~/eda/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/flow/results/asap7/gcb_max_reduce/base/.
params: WIDTH=16 N_ELEMENTS=64 MODE=MAX OUTPUT=BOTH SIGNED_CMP=1 TIE_LOW=1 REG_STAGES=0 (combinational, as elaborated by the RTL-Baseline sv2v)

flow.yosys: ORFS-bundled 0.68+ (a5af9d690) - ISOLATED from the RTL Baseline's system Yosys 0.68
flow.recipe: default ORFS, NO tuning (no floorplan opt, no timing-driven sweeps, no ECOs, no clock relaxation)

timing.corner: typical (TT FF-libs as ORFS default report corner)
timing.worst_path: input vec_flat -> output max_val, ~1.67 ns combinational cone: compare-select chain interleaved with HAxp5 index-arithmetic (OUTPUT=BOTH tracks the max INDEX alongside the max VALUE through all ceil(log2 64)=6 tournament levels)

power.note: 100% combinational; the ~22 mW is against ORFS's default (high) activity factor for a comb block and is an upper-ish bound, not a datasheet figure

routing.congestion: route converged with no overflow; utilization 59%; not congestion-bound

verdict: TIMING-BOUND. Not area-bound (619 um2 synth, 59% util). Not routing-bound (0 DRC, 0 antennas, M8/M9 free). WNS -665 ps at a 1 ns target - the combinational tournament tree is a ~1.67 ns cone in ASAP7.
infra_findings: ORFS 'make -j 2' from cold races its recursive-make generated-includes graph (fails at 1_2_yosys.sdc / 2_1_floorplan.sdc 'No rule to make target'). Workaround: 'make synth' serially first, then 'make -j 2' for the rest.

kepler-formal (ORFS CTS logical-equivalence check) is broken by the same TKT-021 drift as the RTL baseline - linked against libpython3.12.so.1.0 which the system Python 3.12->3.14 move removed. Worked around with LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> the uv-managed CPython 3.12.14 runtime lib (read-only, no install, RTL Baseline venv untouched). This is a P&R-environment defect to fix (rebuild kepler-formal, or bundle its 3.12 runtime).
Peak route memory 1.84 GB single-threaded - comfortably within the 8 GB host; the -j 2 throttle was for the OpenROAD *build*, the flow itself never approached the ceiling.
